argument: The six registers must fuse into one authored body before they read as six buttons: shared slab scale, asymmetrical seam, layered cuts, and negative mass must carry the composition.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, caption, and furniture hidden, the first canvas must read as a single counterportrait object rather than a dashboard, face, card grid, membrane, ribbon, or generic pixel texture.

A solitary offer must be geometry-neutral. Only a distinct pair plus Enter, Space, the ask control, or an equivalent keyboard path may commit; Delete must restore the exact preceding raster state and R must release memory.
The chosen pair cannot answer itself. The checksum must elect an unchosen register, and a fourth register must retain visible residue that changes a later counter-reading.

v027 changes representation, encounter, and memory: it leaves semantic DOM marks for a p5.js raster body, replaces witnessing with pair composition, and replaces remote absence elections with an internal counter-register checksum.

Delete v027 if p5.js only wraps a static image, if a lone offer writes pixels, if the chosen pair is always the answer, if residue is cosmetic, or if the blind work needs its caption to become consequential.
